target: Brief nearby-DAs returns 0 while the original PlotDetect map-viewer shows ~112 — switch the brief to the reliable development_applications table and drop the brittle exact council filter
findings_summary: ROOT CAUSE: the brief calls the live ePlanning OnlineDA API (get_nearby_das in generate_conveyancing_report.py) with a 200m radius AND an exact CouncilName filter — flaky (rate-limited/timeouts) and returns 0 on any council-name mismatch. The original map-viewer (map-viewer-restructured/app/api/da/route.ts) reads the consolidated Supabase 'development_applications' table and deliberately uses a FUZZY council filter: strips ' MUNICIPAL'/' COUNCIL' + case-insensitive ilike '%TERM%' (explicit code comment). The compliance-engine ALREADY has a DB-backed conveyancing_db.fetch_nearby_das(conn, lat, lng, council_name, radius_m, days) that queries development_applications via a lat/lng bbox + Haversine and returns the SAME shape as the live function — but it is UNUSED by the brief and uses an EXACT council_name='X' match. FIX: brief _fetch_nearby_das opens _get_db_conn() and calls the DB function with council_name=None (a proximity/bbox query does not need the council filter, which is the failure source) and a wider radius (200->500m). Columns latitude/longitude/lodgement_date/determination_date/council_name confirmed present in the existing SELECT; the table is proven populated + recent by the original app (112 DAs in 30 days). DATABASE_URL not set locally so live SQL not run; the 5s statement_timeout bounds the bbox query and a connection failure propagates to NOT_AVAILABLE (honest, #582). No schema/write change; SELECT only.
